reference.description: re-computes the Lomb-Scargle periodogram of the uneven RR tachogram with scipy.signal.lombscargle on the same 512 frequencies, integrates the VLF/LF/HF bands identically, and compares to ecgHRVfreq(method='lomb'); reports the op's LF/HF band powers + normalized units, the periodogram max |diff| (~5e-8, machine precision) and the band-power max |diff| (~3e-11) vs scipy
